purpose: R13 AI-resistant industrial compatibility/material/process selection delta; multi-constraint selection over structured tables rather than generic informational content

hard_gates.ai_resilience: prefer multi-input compatibility/selection tasks where chemical, material, temperature, pressure, flow, standard, or equipment constraints determine the answer
hard_gates.reject: single-formula commodity calculators and static charts if exact SERP is already saturated
